answer: In an island marketplace trading sable and quartz, each AI agent must lock 100 tokens for 30 days before accepting jobs. If an agent signs two conflicting settlement instructions for the same job, anyone can submit both signatures to the escrow contract, which confiscates its stake. Creating 1,000 fake agents therefore ties up 100,000 tokens, and using them for this fraud puts that capital at risk; fresh identities cannot bypass the deposit.
